meta.instrument_note: The five instrumented server files of the staged copy are kept byte-identical as testing/spikes/instruments/x242_NR_Server_<Name>.lua (Bench, Nutrients, Metabolism, Effects, Strength); each step file's edits replace one line with one line (the line count unchanged), and the offline golden trace with the profile and the sub-blocks on reproduced byte for byte before the boot.
meta.cost_note: Every reading is cost, not behaviour: the benches run copies of admin's record against admin's real IsoPlayer (its Java writes land on admin), the ghosts likewise, and bench C fires the first-sight hooks for admin. No behaviour row rests on this session.
meta.timer_note: getTimestampMs is 1 ms resolution: every per-run or per-call cost is a total over many runs divided by their count, stated with its count and its ms total; a sub-block's bracket is two clock reads, so a block well under 1 ms reads 0 or 1 per run and only its total over many runs is a cost.
